versions.changelog:
Initial release of Gate Exchange Affiliate program skill.

- Enables partners to query and manage affiliate/partner program data, including commissions, referred user trading volume, and team performance.
- Supports affiliate program application status and eligibility checks.
- Handles commission/transaction history queries with strict aggregation and API usage rules.
- Requires Gate MCP credentials (`GATE_API_KEY`, `GATE_API_SECRET`) and enforces permissions and runtime security.
- Runs all reporting and queries in UTC+8 with a maximum 30-day window per API request.
- Follows partner-only API usage, replaces deprecated agency endpoints, and includes comprehensive safety and aggregation rules.
